FIRST_BUY.title: 🎉 First Stock Purchased!
FIRST_BUY.text: Great job! You have officially entered the stock market. Keep in mind that stocks represent fractional ownership in real companies. Their prices react to market demand, company earnings, and general news.

LOSS_SALE.title: 📉 Learning Opportunity: Selling at a Loss
LOSS_SALE.text: It's normal for stocks to go down. Sometimes investors sell at a loss to protect remaining capital or for tax harvesting, but long-term investors usually try to avoid panic selling during short-term dips.

DIVERSIFICATION.title: ⚖️ Diversified Portfolio!
DIVERSIFICATION.text: You now hold stocks in 3 or more different assets. Diversification spreads risk across sectors, ensuring that a price drop in one stock doesn't sink your entire portfolio value.
